newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds remain slow despite soaring Chicago.
newsitem.headline: European feeds remain slow despite soaring Chicago.

text.p: Business on the European meals and feeds market remained slow this afternoon despite a sharply higher Chicago soycomplex futures opening, dealers said.
"We only saw a few trades this afternoon as a stronger dollar kept a lid on activity and sellers were reluctant to part from their positions while Chicago soared," one broker said.
Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets traded at $240 a tonne cif Rotterdam. Nov/Jan Dutch high protein soymeal changed hands at $252 a tonne fob Rotterdam.
EU rapemeal traded at 29.10 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine for first half July delivery.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
